structured.what_it_does: Co-designs complete gravity-powered rainwater harvesting systems (gutters, pipes, tanks, filters, faucets) with floating and off-grid communities so rain becomes usable or potable water with no electricity. Serves Agusan Marsh floating communities and sells systems to schools in San Francisco, Agusan del Sur, with proceeds intended to subsidize installations for households with low purchasing power.
structured.place: San Francisco and Agusan Marsh floating communities, Agusan del Sur, Caraga, Philippines; showcased in Makati (RCBC Plaza)
structured.outcome_or_award: Featured Mindanao climate innovator at Villgro Philippines Climate Action Showcase (18 June 2026). Company public posts also claim: Most Outstanding Project for the Planet (UN SDG Awards / UN SDSN Philippines) for project Tubig at Kasanayan; 2nd place Elev8 PH Circular Innovation Challenge Category III (Circular Equipment and Tools).
